therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Visualization of lymphatic drainage pathways for sentinel lymph node identification
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with Stage I and II malignant melanoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of agreement between detection of SLNs using fluorescein vs technetium-99m

results.target_engagement_evidence: Fluorescent visualization of lymphatic drainage achieved
safety_signals: 5 patients experienced adverse events, none related to study treatment
1 serious adverse event: hematoma and scalp pain

context.indication: Stage I and II malignant melanoma
